description: This image displays a nested donut chart representing the percentage distribution of samples across two metrics: sample-level ambiguity standard deviation in the outer ring and sample-level maximum ambiguity in the inner ring, comprising a total of seven distinct slices. Two separate legends are positioned on the right side of the chart to identify the categories. The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)," consists of four slices: "Std: 0.0" in dark blue (49.0%), "Std: 0.47" in medium-dark blue (39.0%), "Std: 0.82" in medium blue (5.0%), and "Std: 0.94" in a light blue (7.0%). The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)," contains three slices: "Max: 1" in light blue (47.7%), "Max: 2" in a lighter blue (38.0%), and "Max: 3" in the lightest pale blue (14.2%). All corresponding percentage values are explicitly labeled inside their respective slices using bold text. None of the segments are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, and the slices are positioned sequentially around the rings but are not arranged in a strict descending or ascending order of size.
